title: averygan/reclip
title_zh: ReClip 一个轻量级可自托管开源视频和音频下载器

paragraphs.en: Download videos from almost any website. Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
paragraphs.zh: 从几乎任何网站下载视频。 轻量级、可自托管的媒体下载器，配有简洁的网页界面。

sents.en: Download videos from almost any website.
sents.zh: 从几乎任何网站下载视频。

sents.en: Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
sents.zh: 轻量级、可自托管的媒体下载器，配有简洁的网页界面。

paragraphs.en: A self-hosted, open-source video and audio downloader with a clean web UI. Paste links from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, and 1000+ other sites — download as MP4 or MP3.
paragraphs.zh: 一款可自托管的开源视频与音频下载器，配有简洁的网页界面。 粘贴来自 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram、Twitter/X 及 1000+ 其他网站的链接 —— 下载为 MP4 或 MP3 格式。

sents.en: A self-hosted, open-source video and audio downloader with a clean web UI.
sents.zh: 一款可自托管的开源视频与音频下载器，配有简洁的网页界面。

sents.en: Paste links from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, and 1000+ other sites — download as MP4 or MP3.
sents.zh: 粘贴来自 YouTube、TikTok、Instagram、Twitter/X 及 1000+ 其他网站的链接 —— 下载为 MP4 或 MP3 格式。

paragraphs.en: brew install yt-dlp ffmpeg # or apt install ffmpeg && pip install yt-dlp git clone https://github.com/averygan/reclip.git cd reclip ./reclip.sh Open http://localhost:8899 .
paragraphs.zh: brew install yt-dlp ffmpeg # 或 apt install ffmpeg && pip install yt-dlp git clone https://github.com/averygan/reclip.git cd reclip ./reclip.sh 打开 http://localhost:8899 。

paragraphs.en: docker build -t reclip . && docker run -p 8899:8899 reclip Usage Paste one or more video URLs into the input box Choose MP4 (video) or MP3 (audio) Click Fetch to load video info and thumbnails Select quality/resolution if available Click Download on individual videos, or Download All Supported Sites Anything yt-dlp supports , including:
paragraphs.zh: docker build -t reclip . && docker run -p 8899:8899 reclip 使用方法 将一个或多个视频 URL 粘贴到输入框中 选择 MP4（视频）或 MP3（音频） 点击 Fetch 加载视频信息和缩略图 如有可用选项，选择画质/分辨率 点击单个视频的 Download，或点击 Download All 支持的网站 任何 yt-dlp 支持的网站，包括：

paragraphs.en: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, Vimeo, Twitch, Dailymotion, SoundCloud, Loom, Streamable, Pinterest, Tumblr, Threads, LinkedIn, and many more.
